big: India has about 28 crore mutual fund folios, yet only about 10 crore SIP accounts. Many households still keep most savings in FDs, gold and property. Financialisation is that shift, slowly.

h: A shift in how India saves
lines: Why is this a big story for RMs?

Mutual fund assets have grown faster than bank deposits over the last decade. Rising incomes and digital KYC make first-time investing easy. The room to grow is large, so your job is to guide new investors well.
